family.description: This domain is found in a number of copper storage proteins. It contains a repeat of highly conserved cysteines. The cysteines mostly follow a C-X(2)-C-X(3)-C-X(2)-C-X(3) pattern, though they often appear at other positions in the repeat as well [[cite:PUB00016669]]. These residues are involved in copper binding. This domain folds into a four helical up-and-down bundle [[cite:PUB00161196],[cite:PUB00161197]].
family.name: Copper storage protein
